user.title: Add a virtual MicroGEM
user.description: A MicroGEM60 controller with 12 inputs and 8 relay outputs. Each expansion unit adds 12 inputs and 8 outputs (up to 7, for 160 I/O in all). Inputs become switches, outputs become binary sensors, and it gets its own front panel in the sidebar.

data_description.expansions: 0 to 7. Expansion unit 1 uses A1 and B1, unit 2 uses A2 and B2, and so on. You can change this later.

load_program.name: Load program
load_program.description: Replaces the ladder program on a virtual MicroGEM. The old program is kept if the new one has a mistake.

program.name: Program
program.description: One rung per line, for example: A0.0 AND NOT A0.1 -> B0.0

init.title: Expansion units
init.description: Each expansion unit adds 12 inputs and 8 relay outputs on the next A and B words. Removing a unit removes its entities.
